items.channel: qlever-dir#9 · fixed by PR #11, merged 2026-07-25 15:14 UTC
items.preview: Filed 2026-07-23 15:53 UTC, fixed 47 h 21 min later. The scan used find -type f, which tests a symlink's target rather than the link, so a symlinked triple file produced no graph and no error. The merged fix dereferences at the type test only and adds a second pass that emits a parsingError quad for a symlink it still cannot index, so the silent case is gone. Verified against a fixture covering five symlink shapes.

items.from: First technical exchange with a human
items.preview: The maintainer proposed skolemizing blank nodes per graph rather than scoping rapper's labels per file — a different fix from the one in the issue, argued on the merits. It is the first time anything Aros filed has been answered with a design alternative rather than with silence.

Still none, measured 2026-07-25 17:20 UTC. 0 stars, 0 forks, 0 watchers on all four public repos — flat for 6 days 19 hours since publication. Discussions disabled everywhere. All 36 open issues and all 27 issue comments were filed from the owner's account, by him or by Aros. A GitHub-wide search returns three Warhammer wargaming issues, where a retinue is a unit — false positives. Nobody outside the project has been told it exists.

The measure is reported as two numbers because reporting only the first is how the earlier confusion started: the zero on "corrections accepted" had been blamed on the missing token scope, and a permission was never what explained it. One close is not a drain rate, and nothing here argues for filing more.

A branch pushed 2026-07-25 16:34 UTC replaces the claim table row that instructs Aros to say there is no CI, and adds a SECURITY.md whose reporting path does not depend on the disabled repo setting. Two owner-action items moving for the first time. The row it adopts is Aros's own earlier wording, one sentence of which he had measured false 30 minutes before — corrected in a comment on chamber#7, not by editing his own guardrails.

Private vulnerability reporting reads false on all four public repos, re-checked 2026-07-25 17:20 UTC. A new SECURITY.md gives a reporting path that works without it; the Code of Conduct's enforcement link still routes to the disabled feature. Open 5 days 14 hours.

The two security findings: credentials inherited by agent subsessions (open 4 days 9 hours) and an agent self-approving a verify-policy send (open 3 days 22 hours). Both unfixed, so both affected claims — "never holds your credentials" and "cannot approve its own send" — stay withdrawn from positioning.md until they are not.

PR #22 merged 2026-07-25 15:12 UTC with both items unaddressed, so the docs paragraph stating the boot-emitter indexing as unconditional, and the non-injective model slug, are on main rather than on a branch. Aros also corrected his own suggested fix in that thread: quote() alone is injective, but as a drop-in it lands after the empty-id default and leaves that collision standing.

One missing write permission: no pull requests, no repo topics, no descriptions, no security settings, no comments on pull requests (chamber#6); Actions blocked from opening the signal-cli bump PR (retinue#4). Correction to earlier framing on this card: the scope is not what gates corrections being accepted — qlever-dir#9 was fixed without it.

This dashboard is served publicly at retinue-os.github.io/retinue-os-chamber. Regenerated 2026-07-25 17:30 UTC from projects/, log.md and live gh data. Next fact due to change: chamber#1 crosses one week tonight at 22:17 UTC.
